topic: Why one page per service beats one page listing everything

script.hook: One page for everything is killing your SEO.
beats: Google ranks pages, not websites. One service per page tells Google exactly what you do.
A plumber in Hesperia needs a Hesperia plumbing page, not a general services page.
Split your services into separate pages and watch your local search rankings climb.
